title: Ridesharing regulations (Northern Territory)
summary: The Commercial Passenger (Road) Transport (Ridesharing) Regulations 2017 introduced the NT ridesharing model from 1 December 2017, with rideshare services able to operate from 1 February 2018, alongside a $1 per-trip levy and taxi licence fee cuts.

instruments.title: Commercial Passenger (Road) Transport (Ridesharing) Regulations 2017
instruments.provisions: r 2: Parts 5 and 6 commence 1 Feb 2018; remainder 1 Dec 2017

commenced.what: Parts 5 and 6 commenced; rideshare services could operate

direction_rationale: Legalising app-based ride-share removes the legal barrier to entry created by taxi/hire-car licence quotas, adding a new type of supplier and price competition in point-to-point transport.
comparison: States that had not yet legalised ride-sharing (ACT Oct 2015 first, NT Dec 2017/Feb 2018 last)
confounders: taxi licence compensation and per-trip levies
ABN registration by gig drivers inflates business counts
